fullTextEN: Hello.
I am Xika.
I am Taiwanese.

fullTextZH: 今天我想说说我去叙利亚的故事。
fullTextEN: Today I want to talk about my story of going to Syria.
Right.
Syria.
Are you wondering,
why did I go to Syria?
What did I do in Syria?
Hmm.
As for me,
I went to Syria to learn Arabic.

fullTextZH: 你一定想问我，为什么我学阿拉伯文呢？
fullTextEN: You must want to ask me, why do I learn Arabic?
Many people ask me this question.

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得阿拉伯文很好玩。
fullTextEN: Because I think Arabic is fun.

fullTextZH: 我们小时候都在学英文。
fullTextEN: When we were young, we all learned English.
English is not fun anymore.

fullTextZH: 我想要知道这是什么字，
fullTextEN: I want to know what this character is,
what this means.

fullTextZH: 你觉不觉得阿拉伯文很可爱？
fullTextEN: Do you think Arabic is cute?

fullTextZH: 所以我19岁上大学的时候，
fullTextEN: So when I was 19 years old and went to college,

fullTextZH: 我决定我要学阿拉伯文。
fullTextEN: I decided I wanted to learn Arabic.
So,
I went from Taiwan to Syria.

fullTextZH: 我住的城市叫大马士革。
fullTextEN: The city I lived in is called Damascus.

fullTextZH: 我在叙利亚的学校学习阿拉伯文。
fullTextEN: I studied Arabic at a school in Syria.
My classmates included Turkish people,
Malaysians,
French people,
and also Chinese people.
When at school,
we had to wear headscarves,
and wear long-sleeved clothes,
which are long clothes,
and also long pants.
But when not at school,
we didn't have to wear headscarves.

fullTextZH: 我们可以穿喜欢的衣服。
fullTextEN: We could wear clothes we liked.
I really liked going to school for classes,

fullTextZH: 有时间的时候走走看看。
fullTextEN: Take a walk and look around when you have time.
But I discovered a problem,
A very big problem.

fullTextZH: 我发现我听不懂路上的人在说什么。
fullTextEN: I found that I couldn't understand what people on the street were saying.

fullTextZH: 我在台湾已经学了两年的阿拉伯文，
fullTextEN: I have been studying Arabic in Taiwan for two years,

fullTextZH: 我觉得我的阿拉伯文很不错啊。
fullTextEN: I think my Arabic is quite good.

fullTextZH: 可是到了叙利亚怎么听不懂呢？
fullTextEN: But why couldn't I understand when I got to Syria?
At my school in Syria,

fullTextZH: 阿拉伯文也学得不错啊。
fullTextEN: I also learned Arabic well.
Listening, speaking, reading, and writing are all good.

fullTextZH: 可是路上的人说话我还是听不懂。
fullTextEN: But I still couldn't understand what people on the street were saying.
Why is that?

fullTextZH: 我说的话他们也听不懂。
fullTextEN: They couldn't understand what I was saying either.

fullTextZH: 比如我说很简单的“这个多少钱”，
fullTextEN: For example, when I said the simple phrase 'How much is this',
They couldn't understand either.
I was so upset,
So upset.
Can you guess why?
Because they were speaking a dialect.
What is a dialect?

fullTextZH: 方言就是一个地方的人说的特别的语言。
fullTextEN: A dialect is a special language spoken by people from a particular place.

fullTextZH: 我在台湾学的阿拉伯文，
fullTextEN: I learned Arabic in Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 是在学校、电视、书上用的阿拉伯文。
fullTextEN: which is the Arabic used in schools, on TV, and in books.

fullTextZH: 但是他们每天说话都是说方言。
fullTextEN: But they speak dialects in their daily conversations.
I lived in Syria for a year,
and returned to Taiwan in 2011.
I really want to go back to Syria to visit.
The weather in Syria is very nice,
it's sunny every day,
and it rarely rains.
If it rains,
it only rains for 5 minutes.
Fruits in Syria are very cheap,
and very delicious.

fullTextZH: 我在叙利亚的时候吃了很多很多的樱桃。
fullTextEN: When I was in Syria, I ate a lot of cherries.
Cherries are very expensive in Taiwan,
but very cheap in Syria,

fullTextZH: 所以我每次都买一大袋。
fullTextEN: so I always buy a big bag each time.
Syrians are very hospitable,

fullTextZH: 就是他们很喜欢请人到家里喝茶、吃饭。
fullTextEN: meaning they love inviting people to their homes for tea and meals.

fullTextZH: 我很希望有一天我可以再回去叙利亚看看。
fullTextEN: I really hope that one day I can go back to Syria to have a look.
Of the countries you have visited,

fullTextZH: 你最难忘记的是哪一个呢？
fullTextEN: Which one is the most unforgettable for you?

fullTextZH: 你最喜欢的是哪一个呢？
fullTextEN: Which one do you like the most?
I also want to know.
If you come to Taiwan to learn Chinese,

fullTextZH: 可是你发现台湾人都说方言，
fullTextEN: But you find that Taiwanese people all speak dialects,
What will you do?
See you next time!
Bye!
